scope: Research-only sweep of current v2 tax-related calculation packages and tax geography inputs. No runtime code, production data, or AWS changes.

jurisdiction.addressDerivedGeographyNotes: Address-derived state geography can route to the Washington workflow, but eligibility depends on taxpayer activity, product/component type, B&O classification, tax period, deductions, MATC treatment, and annual tax performance report status.

exactSourceBackedFormula.formulaText: Gross estimated benefit equals the positive difference between the otherwise applicable Washington B&O tax rate and the preferential solar rate, multiplied by the qualifying B&O tax base after deductions and Multiple Activities Tax Credit treatment.
exactSourceBackedFormula.formulaLimitations: The 0.00275 preferential rate is source-backed. The ordinary comparison rate and qualifying tax base require taxpayer/accountant inputs. Do not apply to retail consumer sales or ordinary solar installation customers.

quoteBillDocumentSupplied: Washington excise tax return or accountant workpaper showing qualifying B&O base
Annual Tax Performance Report filing confirmation
requiredRuntimeInputs.syntheticTestDefaultNotes: data/test_case_profile_defaults_gpt_pro_2026-07-02.json includes a Washington solar manufacturer template, but keys do not fully match the repaired package inputs and are synthetic placeholders only.

records.conservativeDefaultBehaviorIfInputMissin: Show as an accountant-review Washington tax-rate preference only. Do not estimate a dollar value or include in totals unless all eligibility, qualifying tax base, comparison rate, tax period, and reporting inputs are present.

localitySpecificDataNeeded.details: No county/city locality dataset is needed for the state B&O preference. City B&O, if any, is a separate local business-tax module and must not be folded into this state rule.

evidenceSnippets.snippet: RCW 82.04.294 taxes qualifying solar manufacturing, processing for hire, and manufacturer wholesale sales at 0.275 percent and expires July 1, 2032.
Washington DOR says businesses claiming the preferential rates must file an Annual Tax Performance Report by May 31 after the claim year.

effectiveDates.sunsetOrRenewalNotes: RCW section expires July 1, 2032. Ordinary manufacturing/wholesaling comparison rates change January 1, 2027 under current RCW text.

ambiguityOrBlockerNotes: Package can be implemented for deterministic calculations once complete taxpayer/accountant inputs are supplied.
Synthetic defaults use older/generic keys such as annual_gross_receipts_cents and state_b_and_o_tax_rate_percent; implementation should map or replace with repaired package keys.

jurisdiction.city: Rhode Island municipality / local assessor jurisdiction
jurisdiction.addressDerivedGeographyNotes: State and municipality can be address-derived for routing, but actual treatment depends on assessor jurisdiction, commercial/residential/manufacturer status, AC capacity, net-metering or REG status, municipal waiver/ordinance, interconnection date, and counterfactual ordinary assessment.

exactSourceBackedFormula.formulaText: For applicable commercial renewable energy tangible property, annual municipal amount is $5.00 per kW AC. 2025 legislation also states real property with renewable energy resources is taxed at $3.50 per kW AC where applicable. Savings require a counterfactual ordinary property/tangible tax amount.
exactSourceBackedFormula.formulaLimitations: This computes statutory tax/valuation treatment, not a benefit. User-facing savings require counterfactual ordinary annual property tax and local assessor confirmation.

quoteBillDocumentSupplied: ac_kw_capacity from quote, design, or interconnection document
interconnection application or final interconnection service agreement
property tax bill or assessor determination
requiredRuntimeInputs.syntheticTestDefaultNotes: Test defaults include generic property-tax fields and a renewable property valuation template, but no current sample profile appears to supply complete Rhode Island-specific assessor-confirmed inputs.

records.conservativeDefaultBehaviorIfInputMissin: Calculate only a non-cash statutory tax amount when AC capacity and applicability booleans are present. Do not call it savings or include it in totals without counterfactual ordinary assessment and assessor/local treatment confirmation.

localitySpecificDataNeeded.details: Need municipal assessor jurisdiction, local ordinance or waiver status under R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-3-21, property-tax bill treatment, and any pre-2017 grandfathered interconnection agreement status. Practical import should begin with state constants plus case-by-case municipal assessor/ordinance resolution, not a statewide parcel-level savings dataset.

evidenceSnippets.snippet: Rhode Island OER rule sets a $5.00 per kW AC tangible tax value for commercial renewable energy systems and requires municipalities to apply the formula.
2025 Rhode Island amendments state renewable energy resources are taxed as tangible property and real property treatment uses $3.50 per kW AC where applicable.
The rule says commercial renewable systems must provide interconnection and program enrollment documentation to the municipality and tax assessor.

effectiveDates.sunsetOrRenewalNotes: OER tangible tax rule is active after periodic refile. 2025 Public Law Chapter 398 was enacted July 2, 2025. Pre-2017 interconnection agreements may retain prior tax status unless otherwise agreed.

ambiguityOrBlockerNotes: Current repo package can calculate statutory amount, but not benefit value, without counterfactual ordinary assessment.
Need local waiver/ordinance status and assessor confirmation for user-facing output.
Need GPT Pro or manual research to produce a machine-readable municipal opt-out/waiver starter table if RetroFi wants automated locality resolution.
records.gptProFollowupQuestion: For Rhode Island renewable energy property-tax valuation, build a municipality-by-municipality official-source table of ordinances or resolutions under R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-3-21 that waive or modify tangible tax treatment for commercial renewable energy systems, including source URLs, effective dates, whether net-metered systems are treated differently, and whether the data is practical to import or requires assessor case review.

jurisdiction.county: Approved county or distressed community application jurisdiction, if applicable
jurisdiction.city: Approved city, village, or township/local unit, if applicable
jurisdiction.specialDistrict: Approved Renewable Energy Renaissance Zone boundary
jurisdiction.addressDerivedGeographyNotes: State and local-unit geography can route the workflow, but eligibility requires approved zone designation/agreement, designated company operations, official legal boundary/parcel confirmation, local abatement resolution, compliance status, phaseout year, and tax-line documentation.

records.taxType: property tax and local income tax

exactSourceBackedFormula.formulaText: Gross annual tax relief equals eligible state education tax, real property tax, personal property tax, and applicable local income tax otherwise due for approved renewable-energy company operations inside the approved zone, multiplied by the benefit-share phaseout multiplier. Exclude federal taxes, local bond obligations, school sinking fund taxes, special assessments, Michigan sales/use tax, and Michigan Corporate Income Tax unless later official authority says otherwise.
exactSourceBackedFormula.formulaLimitations: Formula is safe only if phaseout_multiplier is the benefit-share multiplier. Do not confuse with Treasury ESA acquisition-cost multipliers, which are 0.00/.25/.50/.75 for a different base.

requiredRuntimeInputs.syntheticTestDefaultNotes: Test defaults include a Michigan RERZ template and some synthetic tax documents, but the fixture data intentionally leaves approval and eligible tax-line facts unconfirmed or suppressed.

records.conservativeDefaultBehaviorIfInputMissin: Suppress dollar estimate. Show only a special economic-development tax workflow until approved program documents, parcel/boundary confirmation, compliance status, phaseout year, and eligible tax-line documentation are present.

localitySpecificDataNeeded.details: Need approved RERZ legal descriptions/maps, local-unit abatement resolutions, parcel-in-zone confirmation, assessor/ESA statements, and local income-tax applicability. Existing research did not identify a complete current official statewide machine-readable RERZ boundary dataset.

evidenceSnippets.snippet: MEDC says RERZ benefits apply only to designated company operations within zone boundaries and exclude sales/use tax while abating specified state/local taxes.
MEDC says RERZ taxes can be abated up to 15 years and tax relief is phased out in 25 percent increments over the last three years.
Michigan Treasury says ESA reduction is 100% during the full exemption period and reduced by 25% per year during the three-year phaseout.

effectiveDates.sunsetOrRenewalNotes: No universal program sunset for all approved zones was identified. Each approved zone has a document-specific term, phaseout schedule, expiration/revocation status, and possible effects from 2024 Renaissance Zone amendments.

ambiguityOrBlockerNotes: No complete official statewide machine-readable RERZ boundary dataset was found in existing repo research.
Calculation depends on approved zone docs and actual tax lines, not just address.
The live v2 effect id still uses tax_credit naming in some metadata; implementation should classify as tax_abatement/tax_exemption.
records.gptProFollowupQuestion: For Michigan Renewable Energy Renaissance Zones, identify official current sources for approved RERZ boundaries, active/expired/revoked zone status, approved company/project names, local-unit resolutions, and phaseout schedules. Return a machine-readable import recommendation with source URLs, whether each source is official, and whether any complete statewide GIS/boundary dataset exists.
